title: Entropy-regulated dielectric friction in a eutectic electrolyte unlocks 150 °C high-performance Li metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE02417C, Paper
Yaodong Huo, Duanduan Li, Chunkun Song, Qiyue Zhao, Yongqi Wang, Yong Gao, Tuotuo Ma, Xiaojun Gu, Yuliang Gao
We propose an insight into dielectric friction regulation to rationally design a high-entropy eutectic electrolyte (HEEE) for the extreme-temperature operation of Li metal batteries.
